claim: Only files matching the declared policy enter the agent's view, every excluded file is recorded with a fixed-vocabulary reason, and exceeding a declared cap stages nothing at all.

steps.label: staging a small repository
steps.evidence: only two files entered the agent's view

steps.label: every excluded file carries a reason
steps.evidence: staged set + excluded set == source set, exactly
steps.note: Nothing is dropped without a reason. That is what makes a staging policy reviewable: you can ask why any file is missing and get an answer.

steps.label: the manifest lists exactly the staged set
steps.result: no excluded path appears in the manifest

steps.label: a repository over the file-count cap
steps.note: Truncating to the cap would hand the agent a silently partial view — the worst outcome, because nothing would look wrong.
